facts.fact: Cibercidadaos says the Assembly of the Republic has approved in general the bills on Cyber Security and on Combating Cyber Crimes, which go on to detailed debate.
facts.system: Propostas de lei de Segurança Cibernética e de Combate aos Crimes Cibernéticos

MOZ.note: Mentions privacy concerns in the cyber bills only; no general data protection law stated.

facts.fact: Cibercidadaos with MISA Mozambique submitted a position to the Assembly of the Republic on 23 April 2026 criticising the cybersecurity and cybercrime bills for provisions allowing seizure without a judicial warrant and irreversible data deletion.
